headline: University Press Half-Year Pre-Tax Profit Falls 7.22%
summary: University Press Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N747.07 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, marking a 7.22% decline compared to the corresponding period of the previous year.
why: University Press is a publicly traded publishing firm in Nigeria, reflecting trends in the education sector and corporate earnings resilience amidst local inflationary pressures.
